caption: Awakening in its corner installation — the rotating bronze casts the Tibetan endless knot on one wall and two linked squares on the other.

caption: Red Zigzag, a 14-foot 'fence around nothing' in painted stainless steel, installed February 2025 in Norfolk, Virginia, across from the Chrysler Museum of Art.
alt: A tall, bright red zigzagging open sculpture on a concrete plinth against a blue sky, with low museum-district buildings and bare trees behind it.

caption: Red Zigzag seen from below, its painted stainless steel folding back and forth up fourteen feet against the sky.
alt: Low-angle view of the bright red Red Zigzag sculpture rising into a deep blue sky, modern apartment buildings behind, anchor bolts visible at the base.

caption: A close view of Red Zigzag, where the glossy red faces catch the light and the open folds read as a path with no beginning or end.
alt: Close-up of the glossy red faceted beams of Red Zigzag against a blue sky with thin clouds.

alt: The red Red Zigzag sculpture on a plinth at a street corner, with a Chrysler Museum of Art sign and the museum grounds across the road.

alt: Street-level view of the red zigzag sculpture on a planted median at a downtown intersection, with roads, trees, and city buildings around it.

alt: The bright red zigzag sculpture photographed straight on against a white brick building, standing on a concrete plinth.

caption: Red Zigzag being lifted into place by crane on installation day, February 14, 2025.
alt: The red zigzag sculpture suspended from a tall yellow crane against a clear blue sky during installation, with a truck and workers below.
